rule_order: Use only frozen listing paths, filename instance identifiers, and dataset metadata fields needed to identify instance_id/repo; do not inspect textual heldout outcomes or agent claim content before this protocol is frozen.
Mark the twelve historical development instance IDs identified by the published historical campaign as HISTORICAL_DEVELOPMENT_CASES and exclude them from new development and heldout evaluation.

Treat historical overlap at repository or submission provenance as contamination: all records from a repository/submission containing a historical development case are ineligible for an independent heldout claim; retain their records as HISTORICAL_OVERLAP_EXCLUDED.

For remaining new agent trajectories with parseable stable instance IDs, group by repository first; where repository is absent, group by normalized submission/run ID; where both are absent, do not assign to an evaluation split.

Assign each eligible group deterministically from SHA256(UTF8('PGOP1_RUN_001_SPLIT_V1|'+group_key)): first hex digit 0-3 => NEW_DEVELOPMENT; 4-7 => HELDOUT; 8-f => UNUSED_RESERVE. All evidence for the same group remains in that group.

Where multiple trajectories share one instance ID and distinct submission IDs, preserve each execution identity, but group together if repository matches; never split linked evidence across development and heldout.
Dataset membership overlap across Full/Lite/Verified/Multilingual is tracked as one canonical instance identity plus membership set; duplicate dataset appearances do not count as independent cases.
Freeze assigned IDs and group keys before opening heldout outcome-bearing fields. After inspection, any code tuning contaminates heldout and requires a fresh independent heldout selection.
